formalized_ms: The Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction theorem

formalized_ms: Integral points on character varieties of curves

formalized_ms: The reverse logarithmic Kodaira inequality and additivity
gap: Lean is only the negative-fiber branch of a companion paper's log additivity; no orbifold/log/ordinary Iitaka subadditivity at all.

formalized_ms: Symmetry of semialgebraic bounded domains with compact quotient

formalized_ms: Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions
gap: Lean is only a compactness lemma for chart-field retractions; neither uniform Cartier sections nor bounded klt complements with index N(d,eps) are stated.
quote: Uniform Cartier sections, bounded klt complements, and the paper's real-boundary and companion conclusions are outside this supporting statement.

formalized_ms: Asymptotically minimal maxima of real Littlewood polynomials
gap: Headline is two-sided ultraflatness (lower bound (1-ε)√N too); Lean gives only the max upper bound and L^p flatness; merit-factor corollary absent.
quote: The formalization gives real Littlewood polynomials of every sufficiently large length whose maximum modulus on the unit circle is at most $(1+\eta)\sqrt N$ for any fixed $\eta>0$.

formalized_ms: The maximal triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point
gap: Headline annular r-variation bound (every r>2) is stronger; Lean has only the two-endpoint maximal L3xL3->L3/2 estimate.

formalized_ms: The dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
gap: Lean covers only ratio q=1/2 (dyadic); headline is every q in (0,1). Note describes the dyadic case accurately but never flags general q.
quote: The formalization proves the dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.

formalized_ms: A nonspectrahedral hyperbolicity cone
gap: Lean: explicit degree-20 cone is not spectrahedral (no LMI). Headline: no semidefinite lift with auxiliary variables; that explicit cone does have one.
quote: The formalized counterexample is an explicit homogeneous polynomial of degree $20$ in $23$ real variables.

formalized_ms: Randomized quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games
gap: Deterministic algorithm, exact values and optimal positional strategies, stochastic and parity extensions; Lean has only the Monte Carlo (prob ≥7/8) algorithm plus Truffet counterexample.
quote: The formalized result gives one randomized algorithm for the complete zero-threshold winning set of every finite mean-payoff game with signed binary weights.

formalized_ms: Approximate counting of common bases of two matroids
gap: Headline counts common integer bases of two integral polymatroids with binary capacities via rank oracles; Lean is only the 0/1 matroid common-bases case.
quote: The formalized result gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for the number of common bases of two equal-rank matroids on an enumerated finite ground set, using independence oracles.

formalized_ms: Polynomial Hitting Lists for Noncommutative Rational Formulas (also One Rational Matrix Hitting Point for Noncommutative Formulas)
gap: No positive-characteristic uniform tuple (O(n^3 s^6), poly(log p) time); char-0 point lacks its poly-time and O(ns^2) bounds.
quote: The paper's deterministic polynomial bit-construction bound and matrix-dimension bound $O(ns^2)$ are not separately asserted in it.

formalized_ms: Near-square-root logarithmic integrality gaps for uniform sparsest cut
gap: Headline is NP-hardness of constant-factor approximation (reduction from 3SAT); Lean is the companion Goemans-Linial integrality-gap sequence.
quote: The result is an existential sequence, not a bound for every size or a computational hardness theorem.

formalized_ms: Exponential PSD rank of positively shifted matching matrices
gap: Lean gives only superpolynomial (n^C) bounds for the unshifted slack matrix and lifts; headline has 2^{Omega(n)} for every fixed shift 0<rho<1.
quote: These selected statements give superpolynomial growth. They do not state the paper's exponential bound for every fixed positive shift.

formalized_ms: Two limit cycles for quintic Liénard systems
gap: Lean covers only quintic classical Liénard systems (≤2 cycles, attained); the headline's uniform bound B(d) for all planar polynomial fields is absent.

formalized_ms: Boundedness and persistence of weakly reversible mass-action systems
gap: Classwise uniform permanence: one compact convex absorbing set per stoichiometric class; Lean bounds depend on the initial state.
quote: A global forward solution exists, and one $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ bounds every concentration of every global forward solution between $\varepsilon$ and $\varepsilon^{-1}$ for all nonnegative times.

formalized_ms: Ergodicity of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
gap: Headline is weak mixing (ergodicity of the product flow); Lean states only ergodicity. The note never says weak mixing is not formalized.
quote: The formalization proves that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to $\pi$ is ergodic for normalized area times uniform angular measure.

formalized_ms: A zero-entropy system without a smooth positive-volume model
gap: Lean asserts only finite Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy, not zero entropy.
quote: The linked statement gives finite entropy; the paper's stronger zero-entropy conclusion is outside this statement.

formalized_ms: A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture
gap: Lean has alpha<=2 and h<26m/75+2/3<m/2<=chi; chi_f>=m/alpha>=m/2 is a one-line LP step, so Lean implies headline (plus cm<m/100).
quote: This disproves the ordinary chromatic form. The paper's fractional-chromatic strengthening and the Colin de Verdière consequence are outside this selected statement.

formalized_ms: A power saving for square-difference-free sets
gap: Lean covers only h(x)=x^2; headline is every intersective h of degree k with degree-only exponent c_k (and prime-argument variant). Note silent on this.
quote: The formalization proves a fixed power saving for sets with no nonzero square difference.

formalized_ms: A logarithmic independence bound for clique-free graphs
gap: Lean lacks the O_F(Δ/logΔ) correspondence-coloring bound; the AEKS bound follows from it via max-degree deletion, so Lean is implied (weaker, not different).
quote: For every fixed integer $r\ge4$, there is $c_r>0$ such that every finite $K_r$-free simple graph on $n$ vertices with average degree $d\ge2$ has an independent set of size at least $c_r n\log d/d$.

formalized_ms: A Sharp Threshold Bound for Monotone Graph Properties
gap: r-uniform hypergraph influence bound and threshold width O_r((log n)^{-r/(r-1)}), incl. nonmonotone variance bound; Lean covers graphs (r=2) only.
quote: the formalization proves that the edge-probability interval between probabilities $\varepsilon$ and $1-\varepsilon$ has width at most $2^{19}\log(1/(2\varepsilon))/(\log n)^2$.

formalized_ms: A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound
gap: Lean gives the n^{-2+eta} bound only along an unbounded sequence n_j, not every large n, and uses a smaller exponent than the paper's eta.

formalized_ms: Lech's multiplicity conjecture
gap: Lean is the char-p complete-domain Dutta multiplicity comparison; Lech's e(R)≤e(S) for flat local maps is absent.
quote: This selected statement is the complete-domain Dutta comparison. The paper's full flat-local result in arbitrary characteristic is outside it.

formalized_ms: A Complete Local Domain without a Small Cohen–Macaulay Module
gap: Lean only asserts such a ring exists (trivially, e.g. C[[x,y,z]]); absence of nonzero f.g. MCM modules is missing. Implied by headline, so weaker.
quote: It does not prove that this ring lacks a nonzero finitely generated maximal Cohen–Macaulay module, or the paper's counterexample essentially of finite type.

formalized_ms: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Characteristic Two; also A Counterexample to the Group-Ring Determinant Conjecture; A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Odd Characteristic
gap: Lean groups have odd-prime torsion over some char-2 field; headline needs torsion-free G over F_2 (and nonsofic). Determinant/odd-char are separate companions.

formalized_ms: Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability
gap: Lean is only part (i), the colored-graph criterion; it lacks undecidability (ii), the nonrepresentable lattice (iii) and subgroup intervals (iv).

formalized_ms: The Bass trace conjecture and the characteristic-zero Kaplansky idempotent conjecture

formalized_ms: Quadratic stabilization of the canonical Foulkes--Howe map
gap: Lean gives Foulkes-Howe surjectivity for b>=a(a-1), so the sixth case only for b>=30; headline embedding for 6<=b<30 is missing.

formalized_ms: Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four

formalized_ms: Exponential decay in two-dimensional classical O(n) models
